title: How Far Back Should Resume Experience Go?
description:
How far back should your resume experience be? Is it a certain number of jobs? Number of years? The main thing to ask is “Is this job relevant to what I’m applying for?” A resume should be a focused document that really only shows relevant experience so and old jobs that don’t support that experience take it off. #resume #resumetips #resumetok #resumehelp #resumetemplate #jobseeker #jobsearch

transcript: how far back should your ré experience actually go only one question to ask yourself is a job on your resumé relevant to what you're applying for yes or no now largely that is down to the title but also the experience that you've got in that job any job that no longer serves to support your current experience either just turn it off or if it is close you can always redo your achievements to show more relevant experience and after that maybe you're only left with two jobs as long as they're relevant experience that's okay
